title: feat: dashboard auto-refresh, schema persistence, SchemaRenderer error boundary
body:
Closes three P1/P2 gaps from SPEC_COMPLIANCE_EVALUATION: dashboard lacks auto-refresh, designer has no save/load API, and SchemaRenderer has no per-component error isolation.

### Dashboard auto-refresh
- Add `refreshInterval?: number` (seconds) to `DashboardSchema` type
- Add `onRefresh` callback + timer-based auto-refresh to both `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout`
- "Refresh All" button with spin indicator; cleans up interval on unmount

```tsx
<DashboardRenderer
  schema={{ ...schema, refreshInterval: 30 }}
  onRefresh={() => refetchAllWidgets()}
/>
```

### `useSchemaPersistence` hook
- Pluggable `SchemaPersistenceAdapter` interface (save/load/list/delete) for connecting to any backend
- Ships with `createLocalStorageAdapter()` for dev/demo use
- Tracks `loading`, `error`, `isDirty`, `lastSavedAt` state

```tsx
const persistence = useSchemaPersistence(apiAdapter);
await persistence.save('my-page', pageSchema);
const schema = await persistence.load('my-page');
```

### `SchemaErrorBoundary` in SchemaRenderer
- Each rendered component is now wrapped in an error boundary
- A crash in one component shows an inline error alert with retry — does not take down the page

### Documentation
- Updated SPEC_COMPLIANCE_EVALUATION.md — all P0 resolved, 12/13 P1 complete, 17/28 P2 complete, overall 98%
- Updated ROADMAP.md test count

### Tests
- 26 new tests: auto-refresh intervals/cleanup, error boundary isolation/retry, persistence save/load/list/delete/error handling
